defect_closed: The identity-owning TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE authority was resolved with no required_universe_refs and no identity-specific operation. Once positive by kind/state, the custom scope keys temporal_identity_contract_refs and identity_surface_jointly_satisfied alone decided the identity gate, so an actual but out-of-scope TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE snapshot could own identity for a comparison merely by carrying those keys. Accepted owner archaeology treats temporal identity as source-native scoping material.

pre_repair_discrimination.method: production file reverted to e88cfeb10, new court tests executed

precedence_note: An out-of-scope identity owner fails the temporal_evidence slot and therefore surfaces in the higher-precedence TEMPORAL_INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY state rather than TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED. Both are lawful refusals. Witnesses discriminate the intended mechanism by asserting on the temporal_evidence resolution record (AUTHORITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH) and comparability_status (NOT_COMPARABLE) rather than on one arbitrary state label. Total precedence is unchanged.

repair.change: the temporal_evidence slot now resolves with required_universe_refs=(universes[0], universes[1]), reusing the existing resolve_required_authority universe-scope machinery. No new authority kind, identity registry, or ontology is created; the existing owner path is simply asked whether it covers the compared scope.
